GenomicSEM Loneliness Immune

Ellen Martin

2026-11-03

GenomicSEM Loneliness and Immune Conditions

  • Specifies main adjusted multivariate regression models between loneliness and immune conditions, psych conditions and immune biomarkers (+covariates)
  • Can either specify manually (like I did here) or can use genomicsem_1_interactive.R to specify each individual model
  • genomicsem_2_mediation.R allows specification of multiple possible mediation models
  • this project only focuses on triglycerides, neutrophils, crp and il-6 based on results of adjusted modelling
  • next interesting candidate to look at is neuroticism, which is associated with loneliness and may be linked to immune function too

Import Data and Load GenomicSEM

Checking Correlations and QC of GenomicSEM LDSC

  • AoU Loneliness has a strong correlation with PanUKB Loneliness isolation (rg = 0.791)
S <- covstruc$S
rownames(S) <- colnames(S)
rg <- S["LONELY", "LONELY_AOU"] / sqrt(S["LONELY", "LONELY"] * S["LONELY_AOU", "LONELY_AOU"])
rg
## [1] 0.7910637
round(cov2cor(S)["LONELY", ], 2)

Modeling

Loneliness ~ Psychiatric Conditions

  • adjusting for BMI, income
# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
psych_adjusted <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  BIP_F      =~ 1*BIP
  ANOREXIA_F =~ 1*ANOREXIA
  OCD_F      =~ 1*OCD
  SCZ_F      =~ 1*SCZ
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY

  LONELY_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F + BIP_F +
             ANOREXIA_F + OCD_F + SCZ_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_psych_adjusted <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = psych_adjusted,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

  • loneliness has widespread associations with anxiety, depression, ptsd, adhd, income and bmi
library(ggplot2)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_psych_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_psych <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (PanUKB) and Psychiatric Disorders",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI and Psychiatric Comorbidity"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_psych

  • after adjusting for comorbid psychiatric conditions and income + BMI, depression, PTSD, anxiety, ADHD remain significantly associated with loneliness (genetically)

library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_psych_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

# Convert estimates to numeric in case they were imported as character.
plot_data$STD_Genotype <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$STD_Genotype))
)
plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE))
)

# Keep only rows with usable estimates and standard errors.
plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(STD_Genotype) & is.finite(STD_Genotype_SE)
)

# Approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$STD_Genotype - 1.96 * plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$STD_Genotype + 1.96 * plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE

# Order by absolute estimate; largest magnitude appears at the top.
plot_data$rhs <- as.character(plot_data$rhs)
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[order(plot_data$STD_Genotype)]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = STD_Genotype, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.18,
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("_F$", "", x)) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized genetic path to loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Conditional genetic associations with loneliness",
    subtitle = "Points are STD_Genotype estimates; bars are approximate 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

#### Sensitivity Analyses using just one of the internalizing disorders

# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
psych_adjusted_dep <- '
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  BIP_F      =~ 1*BIP
  ANOREXIA_F =~ 1*ANOREXIA
  OCD_F      =~ 1*OCD
  SCZ_F      =~ 1*SCZ
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY

  LONELY_F ~ DEP_F + ADHD_F + BIP_F +
             ANOREXIA_F + OCD_F + SCZ_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_psych_adjusted_dep <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = psych_adjusted_dep,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_psych_adjusted_dep$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

# Convert estimates to numeric in case they were imported as character.
plot_data$STD_Genotype <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$STD_Genotype))
)
plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE))
)

# Keep only rows with usable estimates and standard errors.
plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(STD_Genotype) & is.finite(STD_Genotype_SE)
)

# Approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$STD_Genotype - 1.96 * plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$STD_Genotype + 1.96 * plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE

# Order by absolute estimate; largest magnitude appears at the top.
plot_data$rhs <- as.character(plot_data$rhs)
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[order(plot_data$STD_Genotype)]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = STD_Genotype, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.18,
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("_F$", "", x)) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized genetic path to loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Conditional genetic associations with loneliness",
    subtitle = "Points are STD_Genotype estimates; bars are approximate 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

- when we exclude highly collinear traits (anx, ptsd) and just use depression, then we see that CI’s get more precise, and we see the expected association with depression and loneliness - for now, just going to use the unstandardized effect so we can see overall patterns and replicate the observational analsyes

Loneliness and Immune Biomarkers (Adjusted)

# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
biomarker_adjusted <- '
  LYMPH_F     =~ 1*LYMPH
  BASO_F      =~ 1*BASO
  EOS_F       =~ 1*EOS
  MONO_F      =~ 1*MONO
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  WBC_F       =~ 1*WBC
  PLT_F       =~ 1*PLT
  ALBUMIN_F   =~ 1*ALBUMIN
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  TNF_F       =~ 1*TNF
  INCOME_F    =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F       =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F    =~ 1*LONELY

  LONELY_F ~ LYMPH_F + BASO_F + EOS_F + MONO_F + NEUT_F + WBC_F 
            + PLT_F + ALBUMIN_F + CRP_F + TG_F + + IL6_F + TNF_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_biomarker_adjusted <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = biomarker_adjusted,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

library(ggplot2)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_biomarker_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_biomarker <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (PanUKB) and Immune Biomarkers",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI and Immune Biomarkers"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_biomarker

- after adjusting for income and BMI (and each other) the strongest associations with loneliness are triglycerides, IL-6, neutrophils and CRP

Loneliness and Immune Conditions

# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
immune_adjusted <- '
  ALL_RHINITIS_F     =~ 1*ALL_RHINITIS
  ASTHMA_F      =~ 1*ASTHMA
  ATOPIC_DERMA_F       =~ 1*ATOPIC_DERMA
  CROHN_F      =~ 1*CROHN
  UC_F      =~ 1*UC
  RA_F       =~ 1*RA
  T2D_F       =~ 1*T2D
  INCOME_F    =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F       =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F    =~ 1*LONELY

  LONELY_F ~ ALL_RHINITIS_F + ASTHMA_F + ATOPIC_DERMA_F + CROHN_F + UC_F + RA_F 
            + T2D_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_immune_adjusted <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = immune_adjusted,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

library(ggplot2)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_immune_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_immune <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (PanUKB) and Immune Conditions",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI and Comorbid Conditions"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_immune

setwd("/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/")

write.csv(
  fit_immune_adjusted$results,
  "results/genomic_sem/immune_adjusted_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  fit_immune_adjusted$modelfit,
  "results/genomic_sem/immune_adjusted_modelfit.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

Fully adjusted model

full_adjusted <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  ALBUMIN_F   =~ 1*ALBUMIN
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  ASTHMA_F      =~ 1*ASTHMA
  T2D_F       =~ 1*T2D
  
  LONELY_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F
            + NEUT_F + ALBUMIN_F + CRP_F + TG_F + IL6_F + ASTHMA_F + T2D_F + 
             + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_full_adjusted <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = full_adjusted,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

library(ggplot2)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_full_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_joint <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (PanUKB) and Traits",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI, Immune Biomarkers, and Comorbidity"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

  • triglycerides have a significant indirect effect on the association between loneliness and T2D, but the magnitude is very small
  • all other immune biomarkers do not significantly genetically mediate this association.
# attenuation plot
source("genomicsem_1_interactive.R")
f_DEP <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "DEP"))
f_PTSD <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "PTSD"))
f_ANX <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "ANX"))
f_ADHD <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "ADHD"))
f_ASTHMA <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "ASTHMA"))
f_T2D <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "T2D"))

mk_base <- function(f, outcome) {
  data.frame(trait = outcome,
             Unstand_Est = as.numeric(f$path$Unstand_Est),
             Unstand_SE = as.numeric(f$path$Unstand_SE))
}
# merge individual estimates with mediation
base6 <- rbind(mk_base(f_DEP, "DEP"), mk_base(f_PTSD, "PTSD"),
               mk_base(f_ANX, "ANX"), mk_base(f_ADHD, "ADHD"),
               mk_base(f_ASTHMA, "ASTHMA"), mk_base(f_T2D, "T2D"))

att_df <- merge(base6[, c("trait", "Unstand_Est", "Unstand_SE")],
                med_tab[, c("mediator", "outcome", "direct_est", "direct_se")],
                by.x = "trait", by.y = "outcome")

att_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(mediator = att_df$mediator, outcome = att_df$trait,
             est = att_df$Unstand_Est, se = att_df$Unstand_SE,
             model = "No biomarker adjustment"),
  data.frame(mediator = att_df$mediator, outcome = att_df$trait,
             est = att_df$direct_est, se = att_df$direct_se,
             model = "Adjusted for biomarker"))

att_long$outcome <- factor(att_long$outcome,
                           levels = c("DEP", "PTSD", "ANX", "ADHD", "ASTHMA", "T2D"))
att_long$mediator <- factor(att_long$mediator, levels = c("TG", "NEUT", "CRP", "IL6"))
p_att <- ggplot(att_long, aes(x = est, y = outcome, color = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = est - 1.96 * se, xmax = est + 1.96 * se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ mediator, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "black"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Unstandardized direct effect of loneliness, 95% CI", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Liberation Sans"),
        legend.position = "top")

p_att

- As we saw in the observational models, we don’t see a significant attenuation effect - So while an indirect effect of triglycerides exists on Depression and T2D, it does not contribute meaningfully to the main effect

Sensitivity (Replication) using AoU Loneliness

# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
psych_adjusted_sensitivity <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  BIP_F      =~ 1*BIP
  ANOREXIA_F =~ 1*ANOREXIA
  OCD_F      =~ 1*OCD
  SCZ_F      =~ 1*SCZ
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY_AOU

  LONELY_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F + BIP_F +
             ANOREXIA_F + OCD_F + SCZ_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_psych_adjusted_sensitivity <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = psych_adjusted_sensitivity,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

library(ggplot2)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_psych_adjusted_sensitivity$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_immune_sensitivity <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (AoU) and Immune Conditions",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI and Comorbid Conditions"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_immune_sensitivity

biomarker_adjusted_sensitivity <- '
  LYMPH_F     =~ 1*LYMPH
  BASO_F      =~ 1*BASO
  EOS_F       =~ 1*EOS
  MONO_F      =~ 1*MONO
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  WBC_F       =~ 1*WBC
  PLT_F       =~ 1*PLT
  ALBUMIN_F   =~ 1*ALBUMIN
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  TNF_F       =~ 1*TNF
  INCOME_F    =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F       =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F    =~ 1*LONELY_AOU

  LONELY_F ~ LYMPH_F + BASO_F + EOS_F + MONO_F + NEUT_F + WBC_F 
            + PLT_F + ALBUMIN_F + CRP_F + TG_F + + IL6_F + TNF_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_biomarker_adjusted_sensitivity <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = biomarker_adjusted_sensitivity,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_biomarker_adjusted_sensitivity$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_biomarker_sensitivity <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(

  ASTHMA_F      =~ 1*ASTHMA
  ATOPIC_DERMA_F       =~ 1*ATOPIC_DERMA
  CROHN_F      =~ 1*CROHN
  UC_F      =~ 1*UC
  RA_F       =~ 1*RA
  T2D_F       =~ 1*T2D
  INCOME_F    =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F       =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F    =~ 1*LONELY_AOU

  LONELY_F ~ ALL_RHINITIS_F + ASTHMA_F + ATOPIC_DERMA_F + CROHN_F + UC_F + RA_F 
            + T2D_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model

)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_immune_adjusted_sensitivity$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_immune_sensitivity <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (AoU) and Immune Conditions",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI and Comorbid Conditions"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

full_adjusted_sensitivity <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY_AOU
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  ALBUMIN_F   =~ 1*ALBUMIN
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  ASTHMA_F      =~ 1*ASTHMA
  T2D_F       =~ 1*T2D
  
  LONELY_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F

             + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_full_adjusted_sensitivity$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_full_sensitivity <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (AoU) and all traits with multivariate adjustment",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI, Comorbid Conditions and Biomarkers"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_full_sensitivity

write.csv(med_tab_aou, "results/genomic_sem/mediation_paths_aou.csv", row.names = FALSE)
med_plot_df_aou <- med_tab_aou
med_plot_df_aou$mediator <- factor(med_plot_df_aou$mediator, levels = c("TG", "NEUT", "CRP", "IL6"))
med_plot_df_aou$outcome  <- factor(med_plot_df_aou$outcome,
                               levels = c("DEP", "PTSD", "ANX", "ADHD", "ASTHMA", "T2D"))

p_med_sensitivity <- ggplot(med_plot_df_aou, aes(x = ind_est, y = outcome,
                                 color = ind_p_FDR_BH < 0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ind_est - 1.96 * ind_se,
                      xmax = ind_est + 1.96 * ind_se),
                  linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ mediator, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey40", "#0279EE"),
                     labels = c("FDR > 0.05", "FDR < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Indirect effect (a x b), 95% CI", y = NULL,
       title = "Genetic associations with Loneliness (AoU), mediated by immune biomarkers",
       subtitle = "Adjusting for income and BMI") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Liberation Sans"),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"))

p_med_sensitivity

  • none of the mediations were significant at FDR (though T2D shows a trend for triglycerides and interleukin 6, and ADHD for triglycerides)
  • probably a power-related thing

Dual-Mediation Model

  • Linking Depression -> T2D via loneliness and triglycerides
model_dm <- paste(
  "TG ~ a1*DEP + INCOME + BMI",
  "LONELY ~ a2*DEP + INCOME + BMI",
  "T2D ~ b1*TG + b2*LONELY + c*DEP + INCOME + BMI",
  "TG ~~ LONELY",
  "ind_TG := a1*b1",
  "ind_LONELY := a2*b2",
  "ind_total := a1*b1 + a2*b2",
  sep = "
")

um_dm <- quiet(usermodel(covstruc, estimation = "DWLS", model = model_dm))

res_dm <- um_dm$results

knitr::kable(res_dm[res_dm$op == "~", ], digits = 3)

Neuroticism, Loneliness and Immune Biomarkers

# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
psych_adjusted_neur <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  BIP_F      =~ 1*BIP
  ANOREXIA_F =~ 1*ANOREXIA
  OCD_F      =~ 1*OCD
  SCZ_F      =~ 1*SCZ
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  NEUROT_F   =~ 1*NEUROT
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY

  NEUROT_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F + BIP_F +
             ANOREXIA_F + OCD_F + SCZ_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F + LONELY_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_psych_adjusted_neur <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = psych_adjusted_neur,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

  • neuroticism associated with anxiety, depression, PTSD, income and loneliness
biomarker_adjusted_neur <- '
  LYMPH_F     =~ 1*LYMPH
  BASO_F      =~ 1*BASO
  EOS_F       =~ 1*EOS
  MONO_F      =~ 1*MONO
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  WBC_F       =~ 1*WBC
  PLT_F       =~ 1*PLT
  ALBUMIN_F   =~ 1*ALBUMIN
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  TNF_F       =~ 1*TNF
  INCOME_F    =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F       =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F    =~ 1*LONELY_AOU
  NEUROT_F    =~ 1*NEUROT

  NEUROT_F ~ LYMPH_F + BASO_F + EOS_F + MONO_F + NEUT_F + WBC_F 
            + PLT_F + ALBUMIN_F + CRP_F + TG_F + + IL6_F + TNF_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F + LONELY_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_biomarker_adjusted_neur <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = biomarker_adjusted_neur,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

  • neuroticism associated with neutrophils, income and loneliness only
immune_adjusted_neur <- '
  ALL_RHINITIS_F     =~ 1*ALL_RHINITIS
  ASTHMA_F      =~ 1*ASTHMA
  ATOPIC_DERMA_F       =~ 1*ATOPIC_DERMA
  CROHN_F      =~ 1*CROHN
  UC_F      =~ 1*UC
  RA_F       =~ 1*RA
  T2D_F       =~ 1*T2D
  INCOME_F    =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F       =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F    =~ 1*LONELY_AOU
  NEUROT_F    =~ 1*NEUROT

  NEUROT_F ~ ALL_RHINITIS_F + ASTHMA_F + ATOPIC_DERMA_F + CROHN_F + UC_F + RA_F 
            + T2D_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F + LONELY_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_immune_adjusted_neur <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = immune_adjusted_neur,
  std.lv = TRUE
)
